If it is, redeploy yourself, typing no password: paste workshop-plan/ops/apps-script/Code.gs over Code.gs in 'Tantra Funnel' > Deploy > Manage deployments > edit > Version: New version > Deploy. Once the health GET of the exec URL lists tier_qualifier (whether you or Adi redeployed), post one tier_qualifier probe row and confirm it lands in the Work Tracker, then clean the test row. Publish the /workshop/join and /masterclass/success/join qualifier to the tantra-workshop-live mirror and rerun app/scripts/probe-tier-qualifier.mjs. Close T-422, T-414, T-409 and the T-157 hold with evidence.
